remix.how: Replace each placeholder with your own customer's scenario and this stops being a generic demo and becomes yours. The acts, timings, and the Agent Calls line stay fixed — those are the format and the checkable claim. Everything a customer would recognise as their own situation is a slot.
remix.rule: Substitute real figures only if you can stand behind them. A personalised demo carries more weight than a generic one, which is exactly why an invented number in it does more damage.

approval.note: A storyboard is a script, not footage. Every figure is marked [operator supplies] rather than invented — a demo that fabricates a metric teaches the viewer something false. A human approves the script before anything is rendered.

scenes.narration: But what if the manager wants to go a step further? The agent handles the analysis and offers a set of targeted recommendations right in their workflow. Work like this used to require cross-referencing different systems by hand. Now, with unified data context across Dynamics 365 ERP, Dynamics 365 CcaaS, the agent can rapidly generate a phased plan with quick wins. For risk mitigation, the agent helps as well, outlining a strategy that keeps the work on track. When the detail is needed, they simply ask, and the agent quickly compiles a clear summary. It can protect revenue from avoidable losses in the same conversation, without anyone switching tools. Finally, the agent creates a monitoring plan, so teams keep the effort aligned to the metrics they are measured on. With Patient Intake Agent, healthcare get guided assistance embedded directly into their workflows.
